shopify.title: Shopify
shopify.subtitle: Your store's sales next to your content metrics, with attribution per post and creator.
shopify.connectBody: Official Shopify connection (OAuth). You approve the permissions in your store and can unlink it at any time.
shopify.notConfigured: Shopify is not configured in Kreo yet (the Shopify app is pending setup).
shopify.viewerCannotConnect: Only an editor or an admin of the workspace can link the store.
shopify.shopDomainHint: Your store's .myshopify.com domain (see Settings › Domains in your Shopify admin).
shopify.privacyBody: Permissions: {scopes}. We only store aggregated order data (amount, currency, date, discount codes, UTMs and products with quantity). Never your customers' names, emails, phone numbers or addresses.
shopify.connectedOk: Store linked. We're importing the orders from the last 60 days.
shopify.missingScopes: Some permissions are missing: some features won't be available.
shopify.syncStarted: Sync started. Data will update in a few seconds.
shopify.disconnectConfirm: Imported orders and Kreo codes will be deleted.
shopify.salesNote: Test and cancelled orders excluded. Shopify only gives access to the last 60 days of orders.
shopify.youtubeNote: YouTube is not added to content totals (YouTube API policies).
shopify.multiCurrency: There are orders in other currencies: amounts are shown in {currency} only.
shopify.noOrders: No orders in this period yet.
shopify.noProducts: No products sold in this period.
shopify.attributionBody: Create UTM links and discount codes per post or creator, and see the sales each one brings.
shopify.viewerAttribution: Only an editor can create links and codes.
shopify.creator: Creator
shopify.utmHint: utm_source=kreo, utm_campaign=post id (or the creator). Paste the link in the bio or in the post.
shopify.discountHint: Created in your store with Shopify's official API: one use per customer, all products. You can edit or delete it in Shopify › Discounts.
shopify.targetRequired: Pick a post or type the creator's name.
shopify.noRules: No links or codes yet. Create the first one to measure which content sells.
shopify.attributionTable: Attributed sales per link and code
shopify.attributionNote: An order that uses a code and arrives through a link counts in both rows: don't add rows together.
shopify.removeRuleHint: Stops tracking it in Kreo. The code still exists in Shopify.

errors.default: We couldn't complete the action with Shopify. Please try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.not_configured: Shopify is not configured in Kreo yet.
errors.invalid_shop: That domain isn't valid. Use the format your-store.myshopify.com.
errors.invalid_state: The connection expired or isn't valid. Please try again.
errors.denied: You cancelled the link in Shopify.
errors.already_linked: That store is already linked to another Kreo project.
errors.project_has_store: This project already has another store linked. Unlink it first.
errors.token_exchange_failed: Shopify didn't accept the connection. Please try again.
errors.unavailable: Shopify isn't responding right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests to Shopify. Wait a moment.
errors.code_taken: That code already exists. Pick another one.
errors.discount_failed: Shopify couldn't create the code. Check the details.
errors.unauthorized: Shopify rejected the access. Reconnect the store.
errors.token_expired: Access to the store expired. Reconnect the store.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: PDF reports with your client's brand: instant download or automatic email delivery.
reports.downloadBody: Content KPIs, growth, best posts and sales (if Shopify is linked).
reports.brandingBody: The report uses the logo and first color of the project's brand kit.
reports.logoFormats: The PDF supports PNG or JPG logos.
reports.scheduledBody: Every Monday (weekly) or on the 1st (monthly) at 07:00 UTC, covering the previous full period.
reports.noSchedules: No scheduled deliveries. Create one and your client gets the report without you having to remember.
reports.viewerSchedules: Only an editor can schedule deliveries.
reports.senderHint: Shown in the email as the sender of the report (your agency or brand).
reports.recipientsHint: Up to 10 emails separated by commas. Every email says who sends it and includes an unsubscribe link.
reports.consent: I confirm these recipients have asked for or agreed to receive these reports.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalid_recipients: Check the emails (max. 10, separated by commas).
errors.recipient_unsubscribed: One of the recipients unsubscribed from these reports and can't be added again.
errors.consent_required: Confirm the recipients agreed to receive the reports.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.too_many_schedules: Up to 5 scheduled deliveries per project.
errors.inactive: Resume the delivery before sending it.
errors.rate_limited: You just sent it. Wait 10 minutes.

pdf.title: Performance report
pdf.youtubeNote: YouTube data is shown per channel only and is not added to totals.
pdf.noPosts: No content was published in this period.
pdf.noMetrics: No account metrics in this period yet.
pdf.multiCurrency: There are sales in other currencies not included in these figures.
pdf.metricsNote: Followers and views: latest value in the period. Growth: difference between the first and last day.

email.subject: {project} report · {period}
email.intro: {sender} is sending you the performance report for {project} for {period}.
email.linkNote: Download it with the button. The link expires in {days} days.
email.footer: You get this email because {sender} added you as a recipient of the {project} reports. Sent by {sender} via Kreo.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe from reports
unsubscribe.body: Press the button to stop receiving these reports by email.
unsubscribe.done: Done: you won't receive these reports again.

apiKeys.title: API keys and MCP
apiKeys.subtitle: Connect Kreo to Claude or another MCP client to check your metrics and prepare drafts from the chat.
apiKeys.keysBody: They're personal: they act with your permissions in each workspace. Keep them like a password.
apiKeys.name: Key name
apiKeys.showOnce: Copy the key now: you won't see it in full again.
apiKeys.empty: No active keys. Create one to connect Kreo to Claude.
apiKeys.revokedList: {count, plural, one {# revoked key} other {# revoked keys}}
apiKeys.helpTitle: Connect Kreo as a connector in Claude
apiKeys.helpBody: MCP server over HTTP (Streamable HTTP). Authenticate with your key in the Authorization header.
apiKeys.stepCode: Claude Code (terminal): run this command with your key.
apiKeys.stepJson: Other MCP clients (Claude Desktop config, Cursor…): add this to their configuration.
apiKeys.stepClaudeAiBody: Claude.ai custom connectors use OAuth instead of headers. Kreo's OAuth sign-in is on the way; meanwhile use Claude Code or a client that supports headers.

tools.list_projects: Your workspaces and projects, with your role.
tools.create_draft_post: Creates a draft or sends it for approval. Never publishes.
tools.analyze_competitor: Saved public data about a competitor.

apiKeys.safetyBody: AI proposes, you approve: the MCP never approves, publishes or sends anything. Limit of {perMinute} requests per minute and {perDay} per day per key. Every action is recorded in the workspace activity log. If you lose a key, revoke it.

errors.too_many_keys: Up to 10 active keys. Revoke one before creating another.
errors.generic: Couldn't complete it. If you use 2FA, verify it again.
